rationale: The replication successfully builds the Penrose tiling from scratch and reproduces the paper's central qualitative claim: odd-parity multipoles show apparent HBS superstructure but only short-range order, with frustration at high-coordination vertices. However, significant limitations exist: system size is 151 vs 1000 sites, the full MC annealing protocol was replaced with simplified minimization (two-seed energies differ ~1.2%, not converging), the exact spherical harmonic interaction tensor was approximated, and Fourier/Bragg spectra were not computed. Even-parity cases (l=2,4) were not attempted. The qualitative physics is reproduced but quantitative fidelity and full methodological match are lacking.
